name: manual_5cd503
claim: Keep raw SHA-256 and LF-normalized SHA-256 separately labelled: matching normalized digests can reconcile valid UTF-8 legacy CRLF versus LF records but do not establish byte identity; retain original metadata and recompute receiver receipts from actual stored bytes.

decisions.notes: Codex reviewer verified that the Windows normalized digest matched the original 905-byte Mac canary while the 916-byte Windows raw digest differed. Cached sidecar hashes describe write time and cannot prove that later stored bytes are unchanged.
